title: Faction Language Lock
description: A four-image reference-dependent series that locks one NPC faction's material palette, symbols, ranks, and role casting logic.
creative_direction: Image 01 establishes one coherent frontier faction through a casting-board anchor. Images 02-04 depend on that reference and reframe the same world through profession, command hierarchy, and deployment logic without losing insignia, palette, or social order.
